question: Can a maintainer with access to both Vercel projects identify the exact-head deployment rejection and require a successful current-main preview before accepting this dependency update?
rationale: The available evidence shows deployment failure but not its cause; resolving or accepting that hosted-environment gate requires access and operational judgment that the PR diff cannot supply.

options.title: Clear and verify the hosted gate
options.body: Diagnose the two Vercel failures, rerun checks against the current merge result, and require a successful preview with redacted browser evidence before merge.

options.title: Pause the refresh
options.body: Leave the PR open until the deployment environment is available rather than accepting an unobserved Astro runtime path.

recommendation.title: Clear and verify the hosted gate
recommendation.body: Diagnose the two Vercel failures, rerun checks against the current merge result, and require a successful preview with redacted browser evidence before merge.
